comments.author: @aisadal2521
comments.text: I love how this speaks to the human experience, and that the MC is an older woman! We still don't get enough MCs who are older, which is a shame

comments.author: @krazyjdizzle
comments.text: Honestly this style of show couldn’t come at a better time, a lot of us still feel lost cause of the time we had lost due to COVID etc, but it honestly has a lot of promise.

comments.author: @AniToonimationKawaiiArchive
comments.text: It really has that feel to Bojack Horseman where Carol can be quite relatable with stuff happening when the world is nearing to it's endgame and the artstyle brings that whole European animation vibe (like Gumball and Nate Is Late) with the humans, I can tell how promising it will be when it gets released and how it will be a special one season wonder from beginning to end.

comments.author: @tayarcade
comments.text: i just know that i’m going to cry so hard while watching this . as someone with frequent existential crises and death anxiety i literally teared up while just watching the trailer . actually so excited for this

comments.author: @jcf2322
comments.text:
It's giving very Bojack vibes, and I love the fact that it seemingly has a definitive end to it, so you get the sense that it won't drag on forever. 

End of the world stories are so interesting, because in a lot of ways it makes it easier to re-evaluate your own very micro experience in telling ways when it is extrapolated to the entire species and planet as a whole.
